# Stakeholder Review (Milestone 0 Gate)

**Status:** DRAFT · **Owner:** Product/Engineering · **Last verified against code:** 4e6d76f, 2026-10-09

**Reviewer:** Business owner.
**Reviewed:** `01-product/product-scope.md`, `02-business-analysis/*`,
`03-domain/*`, `05-sap-study/sap-lessons-for-afrinov.md`,
`05-sap-study/sap-not-to-copy.md`.
**Purpose:** confirm the assumptions in
`00-governance/assumptions-register.md`, confirm the scope boundary in
`product-scope.md`, and confirm the "piece of the puzzle" architecture
(`03-domain/bounded-contexts.md`) matches what was meant by "study SAP."
**Outcome:** record decisions as ADRs in `00-governance/decision-log.md`;
do not proceed to Milestone 2 (Procurement) until this review is complete.

*Unverified:* no record of this review's outcome is in the repository.
Implementation has continued past Milestone 2 (`01-product/product-roadmap.md`);
procurement was built behind a switch that was off by default; it has since
been aligned to the purchase order template and turned on by default
(ADR-019). *Unverified:* whether this gate formally cleared Procurement.
